name: Firm Ally
body:
School abjuration; Level bard 3, cleric/oracle 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

A creature touched by the spellcaster gains a +4 divine bonus to saving throws versus mind-affecting spells. This lasts for 1 hour per caster level.
